title: A Contract Run Forms a Segment
statement: Let $C$ be a contract for a machine $M$ with entry state $e$ and exit set $F$. For any data value $i$ and configuration $d$ in state $e$ satisfying the contract precondition, the run from $d$ reaches the prescribed endpoint at time $C$’s assigned time, its state lies outside $F$ at every strictly earlier time, and at every time up to and including the assigned time each work-tape head position lies between the corresponding lower and upper bounds specified by $C$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a contract for $M$ with entry state $e$ and exit set $F$
replaced:
Let $C$ be a contract with entry state $\mathrm{entry}$ and exit set $F$, and take an
index $i$ and configuration $d$ that starts in the entry state and satisfies the
contract precondition. The run from $d$ reaches $C$’s prescribed endpoint at time
$C.\mathrm{time}(i,d)$, visits no state in $F$ at any earlier time, and has every
work-tape head position at every time up to and including that endpoint inside the
coordinatewise intervals from $C.\mathrm{lo}(i,d)$ to $C.\mathrm{hi}(i,d)$.
